title: Cedar Relay: filter retries and increase delays
body: The author says this avoids retrying permanent failures and makes delivery exactly once.
contracts: retries is a nonnegative integer. send returns a promise and rejects with an object containing a boolean retryable property.
A send rejection may happen after the remote side effect commits. There is no deduplication or idempotency contract.
sleep returns a promise; rejection propagates. Delays are requested milliseconds, not measured wall-clock durations.
Separate calls share no retry counter. No lock or cross-call delivery exclusion is supplied.
